title: Person Edit — Guide
subtitle: A read-only training walkthrough — a representative set of the page's sections with sample data
demoBanner: Training mode — all data on this page is sample data shown for demonstration only. Nothing is saved here and every control is read-only.
subsetNote: This guide shows a representative set of the page's sections (name, personal info, contact, work experience and education). The real page has more sections: nationalities, professional training, relationships, documents and status — all of which work the same way.

quickStart.title: What does this page do?
quickStart.intro: The «Person Edit» page manages a person's full profile across several sections: name & family, personal information, nationalities, contact (email/phone/address), work experience, education, professional training, relationships, documents and status.
steps: First you select a person from the search box at the top; until one is selected the sections aren't editable.
You fill in or edit each section; most sections are a table with an «Add» button and per-row edit/delete.
Personal info and name are at the top of the form; the other sections follow as separate tables.
Finally the «Update Person» button saves the core person data (the table sections each save independently).

selection.title: Select person
selection.intro: The box at the top where you search for and pick the person to edit. Until one is selected, the sections aren't editable.
tips: You can search by name or national ID.
The selected person is shared across the person Edit / Access / Security pages and is remembered.

name.title: Name, family name & father's name
name.intro: The person's name in multiple languages (Persian and English) plus the father's name. Each language is one row.
tips: The English name can't be changed after the first save (a system rule).
Each language has exactly one row.

personalInfo.title: Personal information
personalInfo.intro: The person's identity data: national ID, sex, date of birth, place of birth, birth-certificate details, marital status, religion, military status, insurance and passport.
tips: The national ID is locked once the person exists and can't be changed.
For women, the military-service fields are disabled.

emails.title: Emails
emails.intro: The person's emails with a label (personal/work/…), address and a «primary» flag.
tips: The «primary» column shows a yellow star.
The «Add» button adds a new email; each row can be edited/deleted.

phones.title: Phone numbers
phones.intro: The person's phone numbers with a label, number (international format) and a «primary» flag.
tips: Numbers are shown in international format (+ and country code).
One number can be marked as the primary number.

employment.title: Work experience
employment.intro: The person's employment records: company, business sector and unit, position, contract type and date range.
tips: A row with no «to date» is marked «Current».
Documents can be attached to each record.

education.title: Education
education.intro: The person's education records: level, field of study, institution, date range, GPA and completion status.
tips: The status column shows a «Completed» badge.
A document file can be attached to each record.

operations.title: Operations
operations.intro: At the bottom of the form, the «Update Person» button saves the core person data (name and personal info).
tips: The table sections (email, phone, work, education, …) each save separately and immediately.
In this training sample the button is disabled and nothing is saved.

items.q: Why don't I see all of the real page's sections in this guide?
items.a: This guide shows a representative set (name, personal info, contact, work and education). The other sections like nationalities, professional training, relationships, documents and status work the same way (a table with add/edit/delete).
This page is for training and all controls are intentionally disabled. On the real page, once you select a person, the sections become editable.

items.q: What does the «Update Person» button save?
items.a: The core person data (name and personal info). The table sections each save separately through their own dialog.

items.q: How do I pick a person to edit?
items.a: Search by name or national ID in the box at the top of the page and select the person.
